metadata.name: A1
metadata.description: label: B1 is the PUBLIC supabase config as ONE dict — sb.default derives from it by formula, so editing B1 repoints the whole doc

metadata.name: B1
metadata.description: the appkit project's PUBLIC config {url, anonkey} — the local Supabase CLI stack + its shared publishable key (browser-safe by design; provider keys stay server-side). JSON data entry: the cell's VALUE is the dict.

metadata.name: sb.default
metadata.description: the config cel sbConfig resolves FIRST — derived from the visible B1 dict (reference IS the dependency: edit B1 and every supabase call follows)

metadata.name: A2
metadata.description: label: B2 is the LOGIN view — sign in to get the token (held in the session store, never a cel); signed in it becomes the session card

metadata.name: B2
metadata.description: =view('login', loginpane(…)): the appkit login card until signedIn(sb.default.auth); then 'Signed in as …' + Sign out. Signing in auto-loads the rooms.

cels.f: =view("login", loginpane({project:"default", authed:signedIn(sb.default.auth), email:grok.email, password:grok.password, status:grok.status, session:sb.default.auth}))

metadata.name: A3
metadata.description: label: B3 is the ROOMS view — your appkit conversations (lounge / groups / DMs, RLS-scoped); click a row to go into its chat

metadata.name: B3
metadata.description: =view('rooms', roomspane(…)): the room list from appkit's list_conversations RPC (grok.loadrooms fills grok.rooms); a row click dispatches grok.pickroom — select + load messages + focus the room chat

metadata.name: A4
metadata.description: label: B4 is the ROOM CHAT view — the selected room's real appkit messages; sending INSERTs as you (RLS), and '@*handle' summons appkit's bot-responder

metadata.name: B4
metadata.description: =view('roomchat', chatpane(…)) wired to the ROOM cels: transcript = grok.roomlog (my rows as user bubbles, others as 👤 name), composer = grok.roomq → grok.roomsend / grok.roomkey; title tracks grok.roomtitle. Pane named 'roomchat' so it never collides with chatdoc's 'chat' (=view pane names are globally idempotent).

cels.f: =view("roomchat", chatpane(grok.roomlog, grok.roomq, {project:"default", authed:signedIn(sb.default.auth), status:grok.status, title:grok.roomtitle, draftCel:"grok.roomq", send:"grok.roomsend", key:"grok.roomkey", chips:false, placeholder:"Message the room… (@*handle summons a bot)"}))

manifests.name: chatrooms
manifests.description: appkit chatrooms (a sheetapp document) — log in to Supabase to get a token, browse YOUR chatrooms, pick one, and chat in it for real. The recipe is four visible cells: B1 the public config dict (sb.default derives from it), B2 =view login (loginpane), B3 =view rooms (roomspane over the list_conversations RPC), B4 =view roomchat (chatpane wired to the room cels — sends INSERT into appkit's chat table as you; '@*handle' summons appkit's bot-responder).
